title: Silhouette from the Right
statement:
You are given the root of a binary tree. Imagine standing to the right of the tree, far enough away to see it all at once, and looking straight at it, some nodes will be hidden behind others, but exactly one node from each horizontal level will be the rightmost one visible to you.

Write a function that returns the values of the nodes visible in this right-side silhouette, ordered from the topmost level of the tree down to the bottommost level.

If the tree is empty, the silhouette is empty as well.

examples.explanation: Level 0 has only 8. Level 1 has 4 and 15; 15 is rightmost. Level 2 has 2, 6, and 17 (6's sibling slot on the right of 4 is null, and 15's left child is null); 17 is the rightmost node present at that level.
Level 0: just 1. Level 1: 1 has no left child, only right child 3, so 3 is visible. Level 2: 3 has a left child 5 and no right child, so 5 is the rightmost (and only) node at that level.

constraints: The number of nodes in the tree is between 0 and 10^4.
